<h2 title="Class MeshBuilder" class="title">Class MeshBuilder</h2>
</div>
<div class="contentContainer">
<ul class="inheritance">
<li>java.lang.Object</li>
<li>
<ul class="inheritance">
<li><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">com.here.NativeBase</a></li>

<div class="description">
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<dl>
<dt>Direct Known Subclasses:</dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-quadmeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">QuadMeshBuilder</a></code>, <code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trianglemeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">TriangleMeshBuilder</a></code></dd>
</dl>
<hr>
<pre>public class <span class="typeNameLabel">MeshBuilder</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Builder for meshes. Such meshes can contain different kinds of primitives, like quads or
 triangles. Both primitives support adding texture coordinates that are mapped to the
 corners of the primitives. See <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trianglemeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>TriangleMeshBuilder</code></a> and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-quadmeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>QuadMeshBuilder</code></a> for more details.
 <p>Note: Normals cannot be set as they are not necessary when using the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-meshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MeshBuilder</code></a>.
 <p><strong>Example how to build a cube using <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-quadmeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>QuadMeshBuilder</code></a></strong>
 <pre><code>    Mesh cube = new MeshBuilder()
         .quad(new Point3D(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, -0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5))
         .quad(new Point3D(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, 0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, -0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, -0.5, -0.5))
         .quad(new Point3D(0.5, 0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, -0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, -0.5, 0.5))
         .quad(new Point3D(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, -0.5, -0.5))
         .quad(new Point3D(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, 0.5, -0.5))
         .quad(new Point3D(0.5, -0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5),
             new Point3D(0.5, -0.5, -0.5),
             new Point3D(-0.5, -0.5, -0.5))
         .build();
 </code></pre></div>
</li>
</ul>

<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>triangle</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trianglemeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">TriangleMeshBuilder</a>&nbsp;triangle&#8203;(@NonNull
                                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;a,
                                    @NonNull
                                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;b,
                                    @NonNull
                                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;c)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Adds a triangle.
 <p>Triangle visibility is determined via back-face culling. Front-facing
 triangles are expected to have counter-clockwise winding.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>a</code> - <p>First vertex of the triangle.</dd>
<dd><code>b</code> - <p>Second vertex of the triangle.</dd>
<dd><code>c</code> - <p>Third vertex of the triangle.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>A <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trianglemeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>TriangleMeshBuilder</code></a> instance.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="quad(com.here.sdk.core.Point3D,com.here.sdk.core.Point3D,com.here.sdk.core.Point3D,com.here.sdk.core.Point3D)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>quad</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-quadmeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">QuadMeshBuilder</a>&nbsp;quad&#8203;(@NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;a,
                            @NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;b,
                            @NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;c,
                            @NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-point3d" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Point3D</a>&nbsp;d)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Adds a quad. Internally, this will be transformed into triangles abc and bdc.
 <p>Triangle visibility is determined via back-face culling. Front-facing triangles are expected to have
 counter-clockwise winding.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>a</code> - <p>First vertex of quad.</dd>
<dd><code>b</code> - <p>Second vertex of the quad.</dd>
<dd><code>c</code> - <p>Third vertex of the quad.</dd>
<dd><code>d</code> - <p>Fourth vertex of the quad.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>A <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-quadmeshbuilder" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>QuadMeshBuilder</code></a> instance.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
